Following the AGMAI release recommendations, we've published how our (much smaller, applied) AI-authored project releases results: https://github.com/jdhart81/viridis-canon/blob/main/RESPONSIBLE_RELEASE.md

  • 18 runs and 114 theorems ship with comparator challenge/solution pairs (Lean and nanoda kernels), certificates and a re-run script: certificates/rerun.sh Run-129 --axioms-only.
  • formalization.yaml links each paper DOI to its Lean module and theorems.
  • We publish the denominator (199 engine runs, 84 submitted, 78 certified) and label 7 of the 18 as elementary rather than overselling them.
  • We flag where the challenge was frozen together with the proof, so that check is weaker.

The proofs are AI-generated (tools and roles are in AI_USE_AND_AUTHORSHIP.md); I'm the accountable human. Feedback on the format is welcome, especially on how to show that a formal statement matches the prose claim. We include claim inventories, but that's the weakest link.
